page.title: Passes (TotalPass · Wellhub)
page.subtitle: Connect your location so TotalPass and Wellhub members can book and check in to your classes from their app. You decide how many spots they get.
page.info: TotalPass and Wellhub pay you for every confirmed visit. Here you connect your location, link your classes and decide how many spots to offer.
page.readOnly: Read only: to connect or change settings, ask a business administrator.

teaser.title: What this does
teaser.bullet1: TotalPass and Wellhub members see your classes in their app and book on their own.
teaser.bullet2: When they arrive, their check-in is confirmed and the provider pays you for that visit.
teaser.bullet3: You decide how many spots per class go to passes, with suggestions based on how your classes fill up.

wellhub.title: Wellhub
wellhub.description: Formerly Gympass. You'll be able to connect it as soon as Wellhub hands us your location's credentials.
